summary: Focused on performance optimization: SEO, network efficiency, server load, and page speed. Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of front-end experience building production grade web applications using React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and TypeScript, now also building back-end apps with C#, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Comfortable across the full project lifecycle, from planning structure and tooling to building components, design systems, and back-end services. Trilingual in Arabic, English, and Turkish, comfortable working across international and remote teams.
arsipaPoint1: Rewrite the internal Medigini platform using Nuxt.js and TypeScript, adopting a monorepo architecture and replacing REST APIs with GraphQL, reducing server load by 70% while improving maintainability and type safety by migrating from JS to TS.
arsipaPoint2: Review agency provided designs for inconsistencies with our component architecture, explain the issues to the agency, and get designs revised before implementation, avoiding component duplication and rework for the dev team.
arsipaPoint3: Built the main pages of the Medigini app using the components we developed, and connected them to a GraphQL API with Apollo Client.
arsipaPoint4: Document  the component system in Storybook and author architecture documentation in Confluence, making it easier for new developers to understand architectural decisions and build on existing work.
arsipaPoint5: Contribute  to the back-end GraphQL architecture design and report back-end related bugs.
imtilakPoint1: Increase ILAJAK's daily traffic from 1,500 to ~6,000 visitors and performance score from 30 to 75 through SEO and performance optimization of its SSR web app.
imtilakPoint2: Lead the migration of Imtilak's web app from Blade to Vue.js + Inertia.js, introducing SSR to cut page load times, boost SEO, and remove a legacy bottleneck, reducing maintenance overhead and speeding up UI delivery.
imtilakPoint3: Collaborate with marketing to deliver 15+ landing pages using Blade, HTML, SCSS, and JavaScript, streamlining campaign launches across multiple properties, Examples:
